_about: Cast sheet read by generate.py and extract.mjs. Edit freely; see docs/VOICES.md for what each field means. kokoro.voice is a weighted blend of Kokoro British voices (weights are normalized). kokoro.speed is a multiplier on Kokoro's speed. post.pitch is in semitones, applied with ffmpeg (resample pitch shift: it moves the formants with the pitch, which suits a child and is a compromise for adults). chatterbox.exag_scale multiplies each line's exaggeration from lines.json; chatterbox.cfg_weight is the base guidance; chatterbox.ref_text is the text Kokoro speaks to make the reference clip.

chatterbox.ref_text: The road was longer than anyone had said, and the wind did not stop for any of us. By the time we reached the village the light was going, and I could smell woodsmoke from the shore. Somebody had left a lamp in the window.

vesna.name: Vesna
vesna.role: Player character. A wandering monster hunter, raised by a hunter called Wit.
vesna.character: Practical, dry, economical. Asks short questions, haggles, notices things, is sometimes kind in plain words and often says nothing at all.
vesna.delivery: Low and level, never breathy, never a growl. Questions are flat, not rising. Warmth lives in the plainest words ('Easy. I know.'), never in the tone. No heroic emphasis.
vesna.weak: Kokoro has no true low female register; the pitch drop is the main lever. If she sounds too bright, try more bf_emma and a pitch of -1.5.

hanka.name: Hanka
hanka.role: Widow, mother of Ola; lost her elder daughter Wiesia to the ice at the rite three years ago.
hanka.character: Worn out, guarded, practical. Talks about milk and mending so she does not talk about the rest. Never eloquent.
hanka.delivery: Flat and tired, a little slow. Stops and restarts. In the decisive scene (hanka_confront) almost under her breath, voice unsteady rather than tearful. Never sobs on mic.
hanka.weak: Kokoro will not crack or shake on cue. The unsteadiness comes from slow pace and short phrases; Chatterbox with low exaggeration (about 0.25) is the best route for the confrontation.

bogdan.name: Bogdan Kral
bogdan.role: The reeve. Keeps the ledger, keeps the village going on forty-one sacks of rye.
bogdan.character: Tired authority. Counts everything. Ashamed of the rite and does it anyway. Cannot afford to be kind where people can see.
bogdan.delivery: Heavy, even, a little slow, as if every word costs something. Never shouts; a sharp line is quieter, not louder.
bogdan.weak: Kokoro male voices skew younger than sixty; the pitch drop and slower speed add weight but not age.

zbyszek.name: Zbyszek
zbyszek.role: Keeper of the Drowned Bell tavern.
zbyszek.character: Defensive about his thin beer, gossipy but careful, worn down. Warm in a gruff, practical way (soup, a bed).
zbyszek.delivery: Brisk, a little put-upon; talks faster when complaining and drops to nearly nothing when he will not say something. Dry, never comic.
zbyszek.weak: None specific; the second most reliable voice in the set.

dobra.name: Dobra
dobra.role: Straw-worker who makes the Marzanna every year. Carries a very old loss that surfaces in the epilogue.
dobra.character: Earthy, funny, sharp, bossy. Hands never stop. Her humour is the humour of someone who has buried people.
dobra.delivery: Brisk and dry, a little gravelly, speaks over her work without looking up. Goes quiet and slow only when her hands stop.
dobra.weak: WEAK SPOT: no model here has a real elderly voice. This is a deeper, slightly roughened middle-aged woman (a 15 percent bm_fable blend adds grain, and the pitch drop adds age). If it sounds like a man in a shawl, remove bm_fable and use pitch -1.5.

jarek.name: Jarek
jarek.role: Fisherman who carved a waxwing for the girl who drowned; blames himself for the thin ice.
jarek.character: Grief held down with drink. Says too much when he starts and then stops dead.
jarek.delivery: Low, thick, slightly slurred pace; breaks off mid-phrase. Never weeps on mic; the voice just thins out.
jarek.weak: Kokoro cannot slur. Slower speed and the ellipses in the text do the work.

ola.name: Ola
ola.role: Hanka's younger daughter, chosen as the maiden for the rite.
ola.character: A child who talks like a child: blunt, curious, unimpressed by a hunter's eyes. Asks whether Vesna eats snow. Laughs at the wrong things.
ola.delivery: Matter of fact, quick, a little loud for the room; no cute sing-song and no baby voice. Quiet only when she asks about drowning.
ola.weak: WEAK SPOT: no model here has a child voice. This is a light young woman voice (bf_lily and bf_alice) pushed up about 3.5 semitones and sped up slightly. Expect a small adult. Keep her lines short and plain (they are) and do not push the pitch past +4.5 or it turns to chipmunk.

chatterbox.ref_text: I made a fort under the boardwalk, but it is a secret. You can come in if you do not tell anyone. Mama says I ask too many questions, and the goat will not eat from my hand.

wiesia.name: Wiesia
wiesia.role: The girl under the ice; the ghost and, in the boss fight, the voice inside the Marzanna.
wiesia.character: Small, wet, close. A child who wants her mother and does not understand where she is.
wiesia.delivery: Quiet, slow, a little too close to the microphone. 'Did Mama send you?' is a question, not a threat. Never theatrical, never a horror whisper.
wiesia.weak: WEAK SPOT: same limits as Ola, and she is meant to sound unearthly, so the light echo in post helps hide the synthetic edge. The game can layer its own howl and water filter on top.

chatterbox.ref_text: Mama, it is cold. I could hear the singing, but it was a long way off, and then it stopped. Did you come to fetch me? I have been waiting by the hole.

miller.name: Gniewko
miller.role: The miller, out at the mill with his family; wolves took his dog.
miller.character: Plain, worried, honest about being poor. Pays what he has.
miller.delivery: Even and a little anxious, no accent tricks. Brightens only when the wolves are gone.

miller_wife.name: Bozena
miller_wife.role: The miller's wife, stirring the pot.
miller_wife.character: Short with strangers while the wolves are about, warm and talkative about soup and the children once they are not.
miller_wife.delivery: Quick and clipped when worried, easier and slightly slower after. Plain.

wojtek.name: Wojtek
wojtek.role: A woodcutter who sits at the middle table of the Drowned Bell from noon and plays dice for real money.
wojtek.character: Loud, certain, a poor loser who is not angry for long. Bets as if the money were somebody else's.
wojtek.delivery: Big and quick when he is winning, flat and put out when he is not. Talks to the dice. Plain, never a performance.
wojtek.weak: Kokoro has no true big man's voice; the pitch drop and the bm_george blend carry it.

halina.name: Halina
halina.role: Sits at the middle table of the Drowned Bell and plays dice for small stakes. Raises on nothing now and then.
halina.character: Dry, watchful, in no hurry. Gives away nothing with her face and not much more with her voice.
halina.delivery: Low and level, a half beat slower than the others. Never raises her voice, even to win.

villager_m1.name: Villager (man)
villager_m1.character: Cold, hungry, wary of the hunter. Speaks quietly and does not stop walking.
villager_m1.weak: Barks are short; any slight oddity in a single clip is hard to hear in the world.

villager_m3.name: Old man
villager_m3.role: Generic bark voice for fishermen, the smith and the old men on the porches.
villager_m3.character: Gruff, slow, weathered. Has said the same thing about the ice for forty years.
villager_m3.weak: Age is mostly speed and pitch. Fine for one-line barks.

villager_f1.name: Villager (woman)
villager_f1.role: Generic bark voice, ordinary villager, the market sellers.
villager_f1.character: Hungry and wary, a little sharp.

villager_f2.name: Villager (woman)
villager_f2.character: Seen it all, shares none of it.

child_f1.name: Child
child_f1.role: Generic bark voice for the girls on the sledding hill.
child_f1.delivery: Quick and bright but flat of intonation; no sing-song.
child_f1.weak: WEAK SPOT: a pitched-up young woman, as Ola.

child_m1.name: Child
child_m1.role: Generic bark voice for the boys on the sledding hill.
child_m1.weak: WEAK SPOT: a male voice pitched up about 4.5 semitones, with a touch of bf_lily to soften it. Expect a small adult.
